title: Aerospace company's government customers on the program (CIA, Air Force)

tellings.quote: do know from the um Aerospace company that I interacted with quite frequently during the assap they did go to the government customer it wasn't always a CIA it was Air Force at times

plain: An aerospace company working on a secret programme reported to a government customer, and that customer was sometimes the CIA and sometimes the Air Force. The physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels this. He says he knows it from a company he dealt with often during AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of UFOs. If true, it would mean that more than one agency oversees private work on the programme.
